query.statement: SELECT PURCHASE_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, PURCHASE_ORDER_NAME, VENDOR_ID, ORDER_DATE, INCOMING_DATE, ORDER_QTY, OWNER_ID, STATUS, IS_HOLD FROM PRC_PURCHASE_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) AND (@vendorId IS NULL OR VENDOR_ID = @vendorId) ORDER BY ORDER_DATE DESC
